LESSON: ULUMUL HADITH HADITH OF HADITH HADITH HADITH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is Hadith important in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the meaning of hadith for better understanding
2. describe the forms of Hadith for a better understanding of the science of Hadith (Qaul, Fiil, Taqrir, Sifat)
3. state the components of Hadith for a better understanding of the science of Hadith
4. explain the types of Hadith (Hadith Qudsy and Nabawy) as the second source of Sharia
